Q5787.reason: Shooting a gun at a person implies malice (intent to cause serious bodily injury or depraved-heart recklessness), and that malice transfers to the unintended victim who was killed.

Q8553.reason: Alcoholic chronic pancreatitis with steatorrhea causes fat-soluble vitamin D malabsorption, producing severe hypocalcemia with tetany, Chvostek, and Trousseau signs.

Q5028.reason: A mere proposed school designation in a brochure and plat is not a deed covenant, equitable servitude, or completed public easement, so it is unenforceable.
